rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for things relating to the armed forces, especially before a noun.

example.english: This military report is not due until tomorrow.
example.traditional: 呢份軍事報告要聽日先交。
example.jyutping: ni1 fan6 gwan1 si6 bou3 gou3 jiu3 ting1 jat6 sin1 gaau1

rows.note: Use this specifically when something is related to war rather than to the armed forces generally.

example.english: This movie is about the military side of war.
example.traditional: 呢套戲講戰爭嘅軍事一面。
example.jyutping: ni1 tou3 hei3 gong2 zin3 zang1 ge3 gwan1 si6 jat1 min6
